purpose: Single-variable test of the cumulative multiplicative effect of training exploration. Actual one-learner/one-actor path, optimizer structurally disabled, small_uniform initialization, verified IPC v2. No trained-policy claim.
one_variable: Exploration process only: iid Gaussian .2 (a969f67 reference and same-day anchors) versus zero_sum_offset (rho=0, sigma_o=.2/sqrt(2), per-step executed perturbation std .2, same NumPy stream). Architecture, reward, int(100*4**a) window mapping, native integer multiplier, MIN_CWND, conditions, initialization and exposure unchanged. No window cap, no buffer change, no startup change.
window_definition: Original int100*4**action and original integer native multiplier, no additional cap orMTP scaling

predictions.P1_gates: All 16 zero_sum runs pass both registered gates (no window >=1e6; boundary-weighted time above 4*(BDP+queue) <1%).
predictions.P1b_mechanism: All 16 zero_sum runs: max_t |sum(a_exec - pi)| < 0.75 action units (about 5 sigma_o); all 4 iid anchors > 2.0.
predictions.P2_loss: At least10/12 pairs outside suspected-limit conditions have lower full drop under zero_sum than same-day/same-host iid; historical comparisons are secondary.
predictions.P3_capped: Descriptive, no pass/fail: in G48-R200-q2, G72-R200-q2 report in-flight p95, binding/unanchored fractions, queue and utilization for zero_sum and same-day iid anchors. If in-flight is pinned near 3.0 MB payload, delay there is set by end-host buffers and is not attributable to the policy or to exploration.
predictions.P4_quantizer: All32 runs: percent truncation per-step in [-.0065,-.0035]; descriptive prediction, not optimizer or network benefit.
predictions.anchors: At least 3 of 4 iid anchors reproduce a window >=1e5 (same seeds, same initialization, same noise draws as a969f67).

decision_rules.adopt: All gates/coverage reviewed; no automatic training. Passing exploration safety does not prove learned performance.
decision_rules.capped_only_failure: End-host-limit hypothesis requires independent socket/environment evidence, never automatic attribution.
decision_rules.uncapped_failure: Failures in window-binding conditions: inspect between-command native growth (PRR/ssthresh recovery path); next single variable is an explicit registered cwnd validation for RL writes, never a silent cap.

low_window_and_packet_metrics: Report all, do not count low utilization as a success
additional_training: NOT_AUTHORIZED_BY_THIS_PLAN; no buffer change, E2b or training automatically
limitation: Two initialization seeds; the a969f67 reference ran on an earlier day, so capped conditions also have same-day anchors. Duration gate is a boundary-weighted approximation. Exploration safety only, not learning quality.
design_amendment: Same-day controls for all16 pairs, instead of only4 high-RTT anchors; five hosts, each pair stays on one host, two sequential randomized arms. Two real12s smokes on EACH host (10 total). No concurrent TCP on one host. Buffers unchanged.
classification_limit: capped_conditions means predeclared suspected-limit conditions, not a measured fact. Window influence remains possible after reducing cwnd below active limits.
ss_namespaces: Root-namespace sender ss captured; absence of peer receiver fields in old ss is not proof of no rwnd limitation.
